title: Not worth your money
text: Not worth your money. Product came and looked good, but after first pre use wash in cold water and with other towels 2/3 came out of dryer already frayed and stitching let go..  replaced 2yr old dish towels that took that long to get a hole or look worn down for lesser quality towels.  Definitely wouldn’t recommend these.

product_metadata.title: Ritz Premium Kitchen Towel Highly Absorbent, Super Soft, Long-Lasting, 100% Cotton Terry Dish Towels, Hand Towels, Tea Towels, Bar Towels, 3-Pack, 25"x15", Paprika
features: This RITZ Terry Kitchen Towel set of 3 reusable kitchen towels come in a variety of charming colorway patterns and include: 1 solid, 1 dark check pattern, and 1 light check pattern each.

RITZ designs dish towels for kitchen tasks big and small. Measuring 25in. by 15in. (63.5cm by 38cm), use dish towels for drying dishes, cookware, and glassware, or as absorbent kitchen towels to soak up spills and splatters.
Built to last. RITZ 100% cotton kitchen towels are designed with sturdy terry-loop construction with special woven technology.

Well-coordinated. These handsome terry cloth kitchen towels coordinate perfectly with the entire RITZ line of kitchen dish towels, dish cloths, pot holders, oven mitts, aprons, and other kitchen textiles.
RITZ Terry Cotton Towels are easy to care for. These beautiful cotton dish towels are machine washable for hassle-free cleaning.
